sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: Frontier Intelligence, Flash Cost - z.ai
sources.snippet: We introduce GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash by Z.ai | Model Library | Modal
sources.snippet: GLM 5.3 Flash GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in Z.ai's GLM-5 series: a 320-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 18B active parameters per token and a one-million-token context window, built for coding and agentic work.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 - How to Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: The model has a 1M context window and can now run locally via Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs with llama.cpp or Unsloth Desktop. GLM-5.3-Flash Guide GLM-5.3 Guide If you want to run GLM-5.3-Flash, please read our specific article for it. Dynamic 1-bit GGUF reaches ~76% top-1 accuracy while being 85% smaller.
